narration: Data preparation extracts reference frames, isolates replacement objects, and performs box detection and hand mesh augmentation.
The training pipeline uses a Reference U-Net for appearance identity and ControlNet for three-dimensional hand pose guidance.
Spatial layout guidance is encoded and combined with random noise to initialize the diffusion process.
The Denoising U-Net processes the latents with reference self-attention, specialized interaction attention, and temporal consistency layers.
The HOI Restoration Module preserves detailed hand and object textures using dedicated memory banks and spatial masks.
Finally, the frozen VAE decoder reconstructs the video frames, producing realistic hand-object interactions.
